summary: Bound native MP4 audio seeking and ordinary AAC rendering by composition endpoints

before.pcm_example: changing-regular-10000.mp4: seek125ms returns320 bytes at120ms instead of160 bytes at125ms; seek130ms repeats320 bytes instead of EOF. Positive200ms origins can repeat the entire3840-byte stream. Equivalent constant descriptions and unshifted/negative controls pass.
before.aac_example: Exact 48kHz media clock with CTTS +480/+4800: AAC clips the positive presentation tail and preroll seek can return no PCM while audible samples remain. Analytical control agrees with elementary decoding within 1e-7; final isolated source regression also reproduces full-playback and worker failures.
